name: The Burn of Columbia Valley

known.article: The Burn of Columbia Valley AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "The Burn of Columbia Valley AVA"

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Warm days and cool nights keep acid and sugar in balance, and the long season lets tannins mature.

blurb.text: A Columbia Valley AVA in Washington known locally as The Burn, on the north bank of the Columbia River along the Oregon border in Klickitat County. It sits between the Columbia Gorge and Horse Heaven Hills.
